[[File:Paldean Winds Key Art.jpg|thumb|300px|Key visual]] '''Pokémon: Paldean Winds''' (Japanese: '''放課後のブレス''' ''After-School Breath'') is an {{pkmn|animation|animated}} miniseries based on [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]] set in the [[Paldea]] [[region]]. It consists of 4 episodes. It premiered on September 6, 2023 on the official Japanese, English, and Asian [[YouTube]] channels and on September 29, 2023 on the official European YouTube channels. It was announced worldwide on August 8, 2023 through [[Pokémon Presents#August 8, 2023|Pokémon Presents]]. ==Blurb== ''Pokémon: Paldean Winds is set in the Paldea region and tells the story of three academy students—Ohara, Aliquis, and Hohma—as they pursue their respective dreams.'' ==Plot== The series follows the lives of three students at [[Naranja Academy]], who have been given the project of making a video about the academy for new students by Director [[Clavell]]. Each of the students has their own struggles, with [[Ohara]] feeling overwhelmed by her role in the band club, [[Aliquis]] trying to defeat his [[rival]] [[Nemona]], and [[Hohma]] trying to find a great story for the journalism club. ==Episodes== {{Episodelistheader|Paldea}} {{Episodelistbody|PPW01|Breathe Out|息をふく|Breathe Out|September 6, 2023|September 6, 2023}} {{Episodelistbody|PPW02|Breathe In|息をのむ|Breathe In|October 18, 2023|October 18, 2023}} {{Episodelistbody|PPW03|Take a Breath|息をつく|Take a Breath|November 22, 2023|November 22, 2023}} {{Episodelistbody|PPW04|Breathe Together|息を合わせて|Breathe Together|December 13, 2023|December 13, 2023}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|Paldea|whitetext=1|This concludes Pokémon: Paldean Winds}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|SV}} {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Ohara|disp=Ohara|List of English voice actors{{!}}Cat Protano|Ohara|Shion Wakayama|オハラ|若山 詩音|top=yes}} {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Aliquis|disp=Aliquis|List of English voice actors{{!}}Paul Castro Jr.|Aliquis|Minako Kotobuki|アリキス|寿 美菜子}} {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Hohma|disp=Hohma|Caroline Spinola|Hohma|List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Marin|ホーマ|麻鈴|bottom=yes}} ! colspan=6 | Supporting Cast |- {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Nemona|disp=Nemona|List of English voice actors{{!}}Olivia Vidas|Nemo|List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Eriko Matsui|ネモ|松井 恵理子|top=yes}} {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Arven|disp=Arven|List of English voice actors{{!}}Henry Mason|Pepper|List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Makoto Furukawa|ペパー|古川 慎}} {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Clavell|disp=Clavell|Pete Zarustica|Clavel|List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Tadashi Wakabayashi|クラベル|若林 正}} {{cast|SV|whitetext=1|Eri|disp=Eri|Emily Cramer|Biwa|Asami Seto|ビワ|瀬戸麻沙美|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {| class="credits-table roundy" style="width: 100%; background: #{{colorschemedark|Paldea}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemelight|Paldea}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" width="24%" | Director
